title: the unit shards run on every pull request
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the card's policy test and mutants locally; the pull request's own CI run is the proof on GitHub and was not seen by the card.

findings.claim: a pull request skipped the unit shards and `unit` in five ways: the fast tier of a card on no full-tier path (D-970), a draft (D-564), a docs-only diff (D-969), a diff with nothing under trialbox/ (the `trialbox` output) and a `changes` job that failed (empty outputs); a skipped `unit` satisfies the required check, so such a pull request could merge with no unit test run; fixed: tools/ci_tier.py prints `unit` (true on every pull request) and both unit jobs run on `!cancelled() && needs.changes.outputs.unit != 'false'`

a head commit whose message holds a skip-CI marker starts no workflow, so no condition in the workflow can make the shards run; the required `unit` then stays expected and should block the merge, but branch protection is not readable here, so whether `unit` is still required is not verified
findings.place: branch protection on master (the owner's settings)

findings.claim: docs/plan/43-ci-and-train-etiquette.md 'Draft first' still says a push to a draft runs the fast tier only; true for every job but the unit shards since D-1357; the page is outside the card and was not edited
